name: SD: Electric delivery-van fleet (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: An electric delivery-van depot, counted every hour: parcels waiting, vans parked ready, vans out on routes, vans waiting for a charger, vans charging, vans in the workshop, and the energy left in the depot battery. Every van that finishes charging has used up about 160 kWh of that battery (a co-flow), and the grid tops it up, so when many vans charge at once the battery runs low and charging stalls. Some weeks a fast-charge bay is open. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the depot (the ground truth is in sd-ev-fleet/truth.model.json, including a stage the depot does not count), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
